name: FIFA
description: The global governing body for football, organizing the men's and women's World Cups for national teams as well as the FIFA Club World Cup for the champions of each confederation.

name: UEFA
description: Europe's governing body, running both the men's and women's national team championships and the continent's top club competitions.

name: CONMEBOL
description: South America's confederation, organizing the Copa América for national teams and the Copa Libertadores for clubs.

name: FA
description: The governing body for football in England, the oldest national football association in the world, overseeing the national team and the domestic league and cup pyramid.

name: RFEF
description: The governing body for football in Spain, overseeing the national team and the domestic league and cup system.

name: DFB
description: The governing body for football in Germany, overseeing the national team and the domestic league and cup system.

name: FFF
description: The governing body for football in France, overseeing the national team and the domestic league and cup system.

name: AFA
description: The governing body for football in Argentina, overseeing the national team and the domestic league and cup system.

name: CBF
description: The governing body for football in Brazil, overseeing the national team and the domestic league and cup system.

name: AUF
description: The governing body for football in Uruguay, overseeing the national team and the domestic league and cup system.

name: FCF
description: The governing body for football in Colombia, overseeing the national team and the domestic league and cup system.
